blocks.text: The module documentation defines key meanings, the one-answer invariant, sanitized file-list display, and the reasons status notes may report that project files are ignored.
blocks.title: Prompt behavior and display rules

blocks.text: Pending carries an optional hint for the terminal, while Answer records whether project settings are trusted and whether that choice should be remembered.
blocks.title: Pending and answer values

blocks.text: The machine ignores input after answering, maps t, s, n, and Escape to the documented Answer values, and returns a Pending hint for printable unknown keys.
blocks.title: One-shot key handling

blocks.text: describe_prompt renders the folder, file count, bounded sanitized file names, and warnings about settings, hooks, and skills. It adds a count for omitted names.
blocks.title: Trust warning display

blocks.text: ignored_note suppresses messages for trusted or empty folders and chooses a reason-specific one-line explanation for declined, changed, unsafe, oversized, unreadable, or unusable trust states.
blocks.title: Ignored-file status

gotchas: Unknown printable keys get a hint; other keys do nothing
Closing without an answer leaves no decision
how_it_works: Maps t, s, n, and Escape to trust decisions
Builds warning and file-list display blocks
purpose: The terminal layer feeds keys into TrustPromptMachine and renders the blocks returned by describe_prompt. The module keeps decisions one-shot, distinguishes remembered trust from session-only trust, sanitizes project-derived display names, and explains why untrusted files are ignored.
side_effects: none; pure display and state logic
summary: Provides the pure folder-trust prompt state machine, display blocks, and ignored-project status note.

symbols.summary: Represents an unanswered prompt with an optional display hint.
Records whether a folder is trusted now and whether to remember that choice.
Consumes trust-prompt keys and produces at most one Answer.
Reports whether the machine has already produced an answer.
Maps one terminal key to trust, session-only trust, rejection, or a pending hint.
Builds sanitized display blocks explaining the trust decision and its project files.
Returns a one-line explanation when project trust-controlled files are ignored.

unknowns: Persistence of Answer values is handled by the terminal/session layer.
